Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision

Class LimelightVisionCameraIO

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.localization.vision.LimelightVisionCameraIO
All Implemented Interfaces:
VisionCameraIO
public class LimelightVisionCameraIO extends Object implements VisionCameraIO
VisionCameraIO implementation for a real Limelight smart camera. Reads MegaTag2 (and MegaTag1, for comparison) pose estimates over NetworkTables via LimelightHelpers, and feeds the current gyro yaw to the Limelight so it can compute MegaTag2 estimates on-device.

    • LimelightVisionCameraIO

      public LimelightVisionCameraIO(String name, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d cameraPose, VisionConstants constants)
      Creates a Limelight camera IO and disables the Limelight's internal IMU fusion mode.
      Parameters:
      name - the Limelight's configured network table name
      cameraPose - unused - a Limelight computes its own pose estimate on-device, so its mounting transform is configured on the device itself, not here
      constants - shared vision configuration, used to obtain the AprilTag field layout

  • Method Details

    • update

      public VisionOutput[] update()
      Reads the latest MegaTag2 (and MegaTag1) pose estimates from the Limelight and packages them into a single VisionOutput. Before reading, this pushes the robot's current gyro yaw (adjusted for alliance, since MegaTag2 needs field-relative heading) to the Limelight, since MegaTag2 requires external orientation input to resolve pose. This is the method Vision.periodic() calls each loop to pull fresh data from this camera.
      Specified by:
      update in interface VisionCameraIO
      Returns:
      an array containing a single VisionOutput, or an empty array if the alliance is not yet known or no MegaTag2 estimate is available
